items.title: Press Freedom Tracker year to date — 2026-11-06
items.summary: 257 incidents Jan 1 to Nov 6, 2026 excluding chilling statements (287 in the same span of 2025); latest incident dated 2026-10-29. By category: Assault 168, Arrest/Criminal Charge 45, Equipment Damage 31, Subpoena/Legal Order 22, Chilling Statement 21, Other Incident 13, Denial of Access 9, Equipment Search or Seizure 7, Leak Case 5, Prior Restraint 3, Border Stop 1.
